role: Historical validation ablation and retrospective test; separate from the final poster's fixed comparison.

targets.position: Ordinal position 1–5, correct InSeq and correct OutSeq

preprocessing.split_policy: Assign odor onset by chronological raw sample index within each session; intersect with contiguous timestamp segments. Reject windows crossing split, recording, artifact, or withdrawal boundaries.
preprocessing.cohort_policy: Keep matched trial IDs across all windows of a target. Fit robust voltage and adjacent-jump thresholds on unique eligible training samples before filtering. Reject nonfinite samples, amplitude/jump exceedances, and flatlines across retained channels.
preprocessing.normalization: For each target, session, and window, z-score voltage and log amplitude using population moments of unique matched training samples; keep phase sine and cosine unstandardized at the signal stage. Fit the readout StandardScaler separately on training trial features.

representations.raw: Flatten the notched and standardized window
representations.amp: 50 ms bin means of wavelet log amplitude
representations.phase: 50 ms bin means of wavelet sine/cosine phase
representations.combined: 50 ms bin means of concatenated wavelet log amplitude and sine/cosine phase
representations.raw_binned: 50 ms bin means of notched and standardized voltage
representations.cebra_raw: Trial-local time contrast on notched voltage
representations.cebra_combined: Trial-local time contrast on concatenated log amplitude and sine/cosine phase

cebra.sampling: Uniform trial and valid patch start for each anchor; positive is 50 samples later in the same trial; independent uniformly sampled valid patches are negatives. No receptive field crosses a trial boundary.
pooling: mean of all valid receptive-field centers
separate 50 ms means by center timestamp

stages.finalist_seed_repeats: Hold the selected L1 C fixed per session; use the repeat seed for both encoder and readout.

stages.architecture_check: For each target, repeat the seed-42 latent finalist with offset5; retune C on validation.

selection.metric: Mean recall of the five classes within each session, then an equally weighted mean across sessions
selection.hyperparameter_tie_break: Prefer smaller C per session; ties between recipes use the lexicographic configuration key (rep, start, duration, pool, steps, arch, seed, decoder).
selection.historical_test: Freeze all Stage 1 anchors and one seed-42 direct and latent L1 finalist per target before scoring. Strict BA is absent where a test class is absent; four sessions contribute to the slide aggregate. Previously viewed, not used for selection.
selection.paired_pooling_panel: Use the same four test-eligible sessions on both splits.
